values.label: only while INDY NXT timing is live, and the half hour before a session (new)

entries.look: Today the nav reads Now · Race Week · Races · Tracks · Career. This address loads the live-timing test feed, so Live comes back with its green dot, as it will on a race weekend. Replays still open on /live from race pages, Race Week and Tracks.

entries.title: The replay on a phone
entries.noswitch: these were faults on the phone; nothing to switch back to
entries.look: Press Replay this race on a phone: no keyboard hints, a pile of cars shows one plate and a quiet +n (his 9 always on top), cars land at their gaps straight after a seek, and the track fills its box with no empty band. The big place and the race bar's place now always agree.
